# ecoinvent

> > ecoinvent provides the world's most comprehensive LCA (Life Cycle Assessment) database, supporting science-based environmental impact assessments across industries.

The ecoinvent database offers detailed life cycle inventory data for products, processes, and services worldwide. Through partnerships, research projects like ORIENTING (Life Cycle Sustainability Assessment), and tools like ecoQuery, ecoinvent enables practitioners to conduct robust environmental assessments across sectors including metals, construction, and agri-food.

## Key Topics

- Life Cycle Assessment (LCA)
- ecoinvent database
- Life Cycle Sustainability Assessment (LCSA)
- Environmental impact assessment
- Life cycle inventory (LCI)
- Sustainability
- Circular economy
- Database development
- ecoQuery
- Regionalization
- Sector-specific data (metals, construction, agri-food)
- ORIENTING project
- License calculator
- Environmental data quality

## Core Database & Tools

- [ecoinvent - Data with purpose.](https://ecoinvent.org): Homepage: LCA database provider supporting science-based assessments
- [Introducing Our License Calculator](https://ecoinvent.org/blog/introducing-our-license-calculator): New license calculator tool helps users find suitable database license type
- [Partners - Database Initiatives](https://ecoinvent.org/blog/partner-category/database-initiatives): Organizations and companies using ecoinvent database for LCA work

## Research Projects & Methodology

- [ORIENTING Project](https://ecoinvent.org/projects/orienting): EU Horizon 2020 project developing LCSA methodology for product sustainability
- [Completion of the ORIENTING Project](https://ecoinvent.org/blog/orienting-completion): ORIENTING project completion: LCSA methodology development final reports
- [European Hydrogen Sustainability and Circularity Panel](https://ecoinvent.org/blog/european-hydrogen-sustainability-and-circularity-panel): Antonio Valente selected for EU Clean Hydrogen Partnership expert panel
